subject: Re: MAP draft & updated timeline for Redwood <> Acme Healthcare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft & next steps for Redwood <> Acme Healthcare

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx):

What we covered
- Objectives: pilot Redwood inference for the patient-summarization workflow; lower inference cost and latency for the clinical summarization use case.
- Success criteria: <10% regression vs baseline on hallucination metrics; 95th pct latency < 250ms; pilot traffic: 5k requests/day.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level) — details in the attachment
1) Security & compliance review — Acme: Elena (owner) / Redwood: Marissa — target complete by 2025-11-10
2) Pilot setup & integration — Acme: Tom (owner) / Redwood: Dev — target complete by 2025-11-18
3) Pilot run & evaluation — Acme/Redwood joint — target complete by 2025-11-25
4) Procurement & contract signature — Acme legal / Redwood sales — target close by 2025-11-21

Open dependencies
- SOC 2 evidence (we can provide our summary and evidence artifacts)
- VPN/SSO access for test environment (technical team to approve)

Next steps
- Can you take a look at the MAP draft and confirm owners + feasibility of the target dates?
- I'll follow up with a short canary rollout plan and an updated estimate (DocuSign link to follow).

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx

Thanks
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft & next steps for Redwood <> Acme Healthcare

Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. A couple of updates from our side that will change the timeline: we have a temporary procurement hiring freeze and legal has moved the contract review queue. Realistically, we need to reforecast to mid-December. Proposed changes:

- Move "Procurement & contract signature" target to 2025-12-15
- Prioritize security evidence and questionnaire completion first (legal needs SOC2 summary before they will schedule negotiations)
- Pilot integration can proceed in parallel but will likely be lower priority for our infra team through Nov 20 while they finish an EHR migration project

I attached our internal POC requirements doc so you can review constraints. Can Redwood provide a short SOC2 evidence packet and a summarized controls matrix we can share with Acme legal? Also, is pricing still valid if the contract moves to December?

Elena
Director, IT Security
Acme Healthcare
Attachments: Acme-POC-requirements.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:27:45 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & updated timeline for Redwood <> Acme Healthcare

Hi Elena, thanks for the heads up and the POC requirements. I've updated the MAP to reflect the reforecast and reprioritized milestones; attaching ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx. High-level changes:

- New target close date: 2025-12-15 (moved from 2025-11-21)
- Milestone reorder: Security & legal questionnaire (complete 2025-11-21) -> SOC2 evidence packet (Redwood to deliver, target 2025-11-24) -> Pilot integration (start earliest week of 2025-11-30) -> Pilot evaluation (complete 2025-12-10) -> Contract sign (2025-12-15)
- Owners: added an "action owner" column on v2; Redwood owners are Marissa (commercial), Rishi (customer success/ops), Dev (integration/SE).
- Dependencies & risks: called out legal queue delay, EHR migration at Acme, and SSO/VPN access timeline.

Answers to questions:
- SOC2 evidence: yes — we will send a controls summary and redacted evidence packet by 2025-11-24. Link to our SOC2 evidence doc: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/soc2-evidence
- Pricing: our current commercial estimate will be held for 30 days from the date on the DocuSign estimate. I'll post the DocuSign link here for visibility once I send it.

Proposed next steps:
- I will share ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx (attached). Please confirm owners and whether the 2025-12-15 close still looks reasonable on your side.
- Suggest a 15-minute sync on 2025-11-18 to confirm legal timeline and SSO access.

Attachments: ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx

Best,
Marissa
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & updated timeline for Redwood <> Acme Healthcare

Marissa / Rishi,

Thanks, I reviewed the MAP v2 and the owners look good. Confirming: Acme will target the SOC2 questionnaire response and legal packet completion by 2025-11-21 and we will aim for a contract signature by 2025-12-15.

A couple notes from our infra lead (cc'ed previously to Tom): we will need a dedicated test environment and SSO access before Dev can begin integration; that will likely take 1-2 weeks after our infra team provides access. We will prioritize the security packet first as discussed.

Please send the SOC2 summary and the DocuSign estimate when you have them.

Elena
